label: Trailer Cinematográfico (60s) · A Expedição Polar (Drama & Sobrevivência Extrema)
description: Trailer de sobrevivência e drama épico no Ártico em 16:9: nevasca branca a -50°C, quebra-gelo preso na calota polar, pegadas sumindo no gelo, aurora boreal e luta humana contra a força implacável da natureza.
resources: sound design de vento gelado e gelo estalando

scenes.prompt: Epic survival drama trailer cinematography in 16:9. Extreme wide shot of a vast, desolate, frozen white arctic ice shelf stretching to the horizon under a pale indigo blizzard sky. A colossal historic icebreaker ship sits trapped and tilted in crushing pressure ridges of blue sea ice. Non-verbal sound design: bone-chilling sub-zero wind howl and deep underwater ice groans. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A 80 GRAUS NORTE.

Epic survival drama trailer cinematography in 16:9. Macro shot of frost and ice crystals clinging to a weathered explorer's fur hood and frozen eyelashes. Warm breath condenses instantly into thick white clouds against the biting gale. 85mm prime cinema lens. Non-verbal sound design: heavy ragged breathing, snow crunching under heavy boots. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: O FRIO NÃO PERDOA.

Epic survival drama trailer cinematography in 16:9. High-angle drone shot: a tiny team of three explorers pulls wooden sleds across an endless labyrinth of jagged blue icebergs as a massive blizzard wall approaches in the distance. Overwhelming sense of human fragility. Non-verbal sound design: rising blizzard storm roar and low ominous cello drone. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: CADA PASSO É UMA BATALHA.

Epic survival drama trailer cinematography in 16:9. A massive sea-ice chasm suddenly splits open with catastrophic force right between the explorers' feet, revealing black freezing oceanic abyss below. Explosive fracture lines race across the ice. Non-verbal sound design: deafening thunderous crack of splitting ice shelf and massive bass impact. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A TERRA SE PARTE.

Epic survival drama trailer cinematography in 16:9. Night sequence under a colossal emerald and violet aurora borealis dancing across the arctic sky. A lone red emergency flare arcs into the night, illuminating endless miles of frozen wilderness. Non-verbal sound design: emotional soaring violin solo over thunderous percussive heartbeat. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A ÚLTIMA ESPERANÇA.

Epic survival drama trailer cinematography in 16:9. Hero title reveal: massive glacial 3D typography carved directly from translucent blue glacier ice, reflecting the cold golden glow of the arctic midnight sun. Slow camera drift back. Non-verbal sound design: grand orchestral crescendo resolving into a lone wind whistle and pure silence. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A EXPEDIÇÃO POLAR.

narration.text: Eles foram até o fim do mundo em busca de glória. Mas no gelo eterno, não existem heróis. Apenas aqueles que se recusam a congelar.
narration.voice: voz masculina brasileira madura, grave, rouca, emotiva, solene e dramática, estilo cinema dramático de superação e sobrevivência

blocks.text: Eles navegaram além de qualquer mapa conhecido.
Onde o termômetro atinge cinquenta graus negativos.
Quando o navio foi esmagado pelo gelo, a marcha começou.
Sem resgate. Sem suprimentos. Apenas a vontade de viver.
Uma história real de coragem e sobrevivência extrema.
A Expedição Polar. O teste definitivo do espírito humano.

audio.musicIntent: Heart-wrenching epic orchestral score with solo cello, mournful horn calls, driving survival percussion, sweeping strings and a towering emotional resolution.
